codeReview.summary: The new OpsEmailDeliveryTable component itself covered the requested table, sorting, expansion, loading, and empty states. However, the feature commit also rewired OpsEmailDeliveryClient back to the legacy filter-card path and gated pagination on rows being present, so the shipped Delivery Log tab did not fully satisfy the intended tab content path and later needed follow-up fixes.

issues.description: The feature replaced the new Delivery Log tab composition with the legacy `OpsEmailDeliveryFiltersCard` import and removed the `OpsEmailDeliveryFilterBar` path, so the tab no longer matched the intended current implementation for the redesigned tabbed UI. This regression was later fixed by a dedicated follow-up feature, indicating the reviewed feature did not ship cleanly in context.

Pagination was rendered only when `attempts.length > 0`, which strands users on out-of-range or filtered-empty pages with no recovery controls even when pagination metadata says more results exist. This behavior later required the `fix-delivery-log-pagination-on-empty-pages` follow-up.

The original status-sort test only asserted the row count after clicking the Status header, so it did not actually verify the required deterministic ordering semantics. A later follow-up added the real ordering assertions.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The worker skipped the fullstack-worker skill's RED test step for a net-new component feature and still reported `followedProcedure: true`, suggesting the skill guidance is either too rigid for UI-structure work or reviewers need a clearer rule for documenting justified deviations.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Handoff `skillFeedback.deviations` says the worker skipped step 3 ('Write tests first (RED)') and added tests after implementation; `fullstack-worker/SKILL.md` explicitly requires a failing targeted Vitest command before editing implementation.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Mission shared state understated the local environment: `.factory/library/environment.md` says `APP_ENV=development`, but mission AGENTS and worker handoff confirm the actual local `.env.local` for this mission had `APP_ENV=staging`, which changes whether the dev harness is reachable.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Mission `AGENTS.md` notes `/dev/ops-email-delivery` may 404 because `APP_ENV=staging`; the handoff also used the authenticated route for that reason, while `.factory/library/environment.md` still states `APP_ENV=development for local dev`.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The worker deviated from the established reusable copy-button pattern and implemented an inline `CopyMessageIdButton` because of Vitest path-alias issues, which suggests shared testing guidance is incomplete for components depending on `@/hooks/use-copy-to-clipboard`.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Handoff `skillFeedback.deviations` says the worker avoided `src/components/ui/copy-button.tsx` due to import-chain issues. Repo evidence: `src/components/ui/copy-button.tsx` imports `@/hooks/use-copy-to-clipboard`, while other features already reuse `CopyButton` in `src/components/features/email-delivery/components/OpsEmailDeliveryAttemptCard.tsx` and `src/components/features/customers/OpsGuestCard.tsx`.

summary: Review failed: the feature's table implementation itself was solid, but the shipped Delivery Log tab state still regressed to the legacy filter-card path in the touched area, which later required a dedicated regression fix. Also noted two shared-state gaps around the worker skill's RED-test procedure and the missing documented fix for CopyButton/Vitest aliasing.
